example.en: The final financial statement accurately reflects all verified revenues and operating expenditures.
example.zh: 最終財務報表準確無誤地反映了所有已查核的營收與營運支出。

words.mnemonic: 如實反映財報用語：accurately reflect (準確反映)。

example.en: Factory employees participated in an annual fire emergency evacuation exercise this morning.
example.zh: 工廠員工於今天上午參加了一年一度的火災緊急疏散演練演習。

words.mnemonic: 多益雙重考點：fire exercise / drill (消防演習)；動詞 exercise caution (保持謹慎)。

example.en: The employee onboarding handbook contains useful contact numbers and procedural checklists.
example.zh: 新進員工培訓指導手冊內含有實用的聯絡電話號碼與作業程序檢核清單。

words.mnemonic: 推薦實用工具：useful tool (實用工具)、useful information (實用資訊)。

example.en: Please reserve a private dining room at the downtown restaurant for the executive client banquet.
example.zh: 請在市中心餐廳預訂一間私人獨立包廂以舉辦高階客戶宴會。

words.mnemonic: 商務宴請高頻字：hotel restaurant (飯店餐廳)、make a restaurant reservation (預約餐廳)。

example.en: Corporate net operating income grew by twelve percent thanks to higher overseas subscription rates.
example.zh: 歸功於海外訂閱率提高，企業營業淨所得增長了百分之十二。

words.mnemonic: 多益財會核心名詞：net income (淨利/淨收入)、income tax (所得稅)。

example.en: The corporate steering committee is evaluating commercial real estate properties for new branch offices.
example.zh: 企業指導委員會正在評估用於設立新分公司的商用房地產物業。

words.mnemonic: 不動產與智財權必考：real property / real estate (不動產)、intellectual property (智慧財產權/IP)。

example.en: Candidates must provide employment verification letters from their previous corporate employers.
example.zh: 求職應徵者必須檢附先前企業前雇主所開立的在職服務證明信。

words.mnemonic: 資歷查核常用詞：previous experience (過往經驗)、previous year (前一年)。
roots: vi 路 → 走在前面的

example.en: The facility maintenance team replaced burnt-out overhead light bulbs in the dark factory corridor.
example.zh: 廠房維修團隊更換了工廠昏暗走廊中燒毀的頂部照明燈泡。

words.mnemonic: 工安環境照明形容詞：well-lit (照明良好的)，反義詞為 dark。

example.en: It is difficult to imagine managing global supply fulfillment without cloud automation software.
example.zh: 很難設想若沒有雲端自動化軟體該如何有效管理全球供應鏈履約作業。

words.mnemonic: 提案設想句型：hard to imagine (很難想像)。

example.en: Please check with the project director to confirm that it is okay to reschedule the review session.
example.zh: 請向專案總監確認將審查會議改期是否可以獲得同意。

words.mnemonic: 確認同意口語表達：give the okay (給予核准/開綠燈)。

example.en: Rewards club members earn points for every dollar spent on corporate business hotel accommodations.
example.zh: 會員俱樂部成員在企業商務飯店住宿上每消費一美元即可賺取紅利積分。

words.mnemonic: 積點與獲利動詞：earn points (累積點數)、earn money (賺錢)。

example.en: The corporate family medical policy allows staff members to enroll their dependent son or daughter.
example.zh: 企業家庭醫療福利政策允許同仁為其受撫養的兒子或女兒投保。

words.mnemonic: 眷屬健保條款名詞：dependent child (受撫養子女)。

example.en: Human resources will post the job opening advertisement on our corporate careers website today.
example.zh: 人力資源部今天將在我們的企業求職網站上刊登張貼職缺徵才廣告。

words.mnemonic: 招募公告與郵政：post an advertisement (張貼廣告)、post office (郵局)。

example.en: The advertising department placed a full-page promotional display ad in the national newspaper.
example.zh: 廣告部門在全國性報紙上刊登了一整頁的促銷展示廣告。

words.mnemonic: 報刊廣告常考：newspaper advertisement (報紙廣告)。

example.en: The contract clearly defines the specific responsibilities of each consulting partner.
example.zh: 合約明確界定了每位顧問合作夥伴的具體責任範疇。

words.mnemonic: 職責劃分動詞：clearly define (明確界定)。

example.en: At the conclusion of the seminar, participants are invited to ask questions during the open Q&A.
example.zh: 在研討會閉幕結束之際，邀請與會者在公開問答環節中踴躍提問。

words.mnemonic: 會議日程大考點：at the conclusion of (在...結束之際)、reach a conclusion (得出結論)。

example.en: Factory employees are required to clock in electronically when reporting for their scheduled shift.
example.zh: 工廠員工在依排班報到上工時必須進行電子打卡。

words.mnemonic: 出勤打卡與全天候服務：clock in / clock out (上下班打卡)、around the clock (全天候24小時)。

example.en: The department director thanked everybody for contributing to the successful software rollout.
example.zh: 部門總監感謝了每位同仁為該軟體成功上線所做出的貢獻。

words.mnemonic: 多益文法必考：everybody 與 everyone 相同，後面接「單數動詞」！

example.en: The resort hotel offers special discounted weekend rates for guests staying two consecutive nights.
example.zh: 該度假飯店為連續入住兩晚的旅客提供專案週末優惠房價。

words.mnemonic: 休閒與差旅考點：weekend rate (週末特價)、over the weekend (在週末期間)。

example.en: Factory maintenance mechanics regularly perform thorough safety inspections on all machines.
example.zh: 工廠維修技師定期對所有機具實施徹底的安全檢驗。

words.mnemonic: 執行檢驗與職責動詞：perform an inspection (進行檢查)、perform duties (履行職責)。
roots: form 形成 → 完整做出來

example.en: She gave a professional presentation.
example.zh: 我們追求為客戶提供專業的服務品質。

words.mnemonic: 專業的表現。

example.en: The heavy manufacturing corporation imports raw iron ore directly from overseas mining facilities.
example.zh: 這家重型製造企業直接向海外採礦廠進口天然鐵礦石原料。

words.mnemonic: 原料採掘與所有格：mining company (採礦公司)、friend of mine (我的一位朋友)。

example.en: After intense board debate, directors unanimously approved the international merger proposal.
example.zh: 在歷經董事會熱烈討論辯論後，董事們一致通過了跨國合併提案。

words.mnemonic: 政策探討名詞：under debate (在研議爭論中)、open to debate (尚待商榷)。

example.en: The updated corporate database server is equipped with sixteen gigabytes of rapid memory capacity.
example.zh: 升級後的企業資料庫伺服器配備有十六吉位元組 (GB) 的高速記憶體容量。

words.mnemonic: 電腦硬體規格必考：memory capacity (記憶體容量)、memory card (記憶卡)。

example.en: Our corporation adopted a green building policy to decrease energy consumption and carbon emissions.
example.zh: 我們企業採取了綠色環保建築政策，以降低能源消耗與碳排放。

words.mnemonic: 環保ESG關鍵詞：green energy (綠色能源)、green building (綠建築)。

example.en: The creative advertising agency composed a catchy promotional song for the retail product rollout.
example.zh: 創意廣告公司為零售產品上市推廣譜寫了一首朗朗上口的宣傳廣告歌曲。

words.mnemonic: 廣告宣傳樂曲：theme song (主題曲)、catchy song (悅耳洗腦歌)。

example.en: Several board members objected to the proposed price increase during the financial briefing.
example.zh: 數名董事會成員在財務簡報會議中對擬議的提價案表達了反對意見。

words.mnemonic: 動詞反對搭配介系詞 to：object to + V-ing/名詞；名詞失物 lost object。
roots: ject 丟 → 丟到面前、反對

example.en: Factory technicians work diligently to maintain all assembly equipment in optimal operating condition.
example.zh: 工廠技術員辛勤工作，以將所有組裝機具設備維持在最佳運轉狀態。

words.mnemonic: 維修保養核心動詞：maintain equipment (保養設備)、maintain standards (維持標準)。
roots: tain 握住 → 握在手中維持

example.en: Retail customers may pay for purchases using all major commercial credit cards or debit cards.
example.zh: 零售顧客可使用所有主要商業信用卡或簽帳金融卡進行購物付款。

words.mnemonic: 金融支付大考點：credit card (信用卡)、store credit (門市購物抵用金)。

example.en: Customer service representatives are trained to answer incoming telephone calls within three rings.
example.zh: 客戶服務專員受過專業訓練，能在響鈴三聲之內接聽進線電話。

words.mnemonic: 客服接聽與通話片語：give someone a ring (給某人打通電話)。

example.en: Visit our official website today to discover innovative cloud software solutions tailored for your business.
example.zh: 立即造訪我們的官方網站，發掘專為貴公司量身打造的創新雲端軟體解決方案。

words.mnemonic: 產品探索行銷用語：discover new solutions (發掘新解方)。

example.en: If the presentation laptop battery is dead, please plug it into the emergency wall outlet.
example.zh: 若簡報筆記型電腦電池沒電了，請將其插入緊急牆面壁座插座。

words.mnemonic: 電子設備沒電口語：battery is dead (電池沒電了)；名詞 deadline (截止日)。

example.en: The corporate executive strategy briefing is scheduled to begin at two o'clock this afternoon.
example.zh: 企業高階主管策略簡報會議預定於今天下午兩點整開始。

words.mnemonic: 會議時段標誌詞：this afternoon (今天下午)。
words.roots: after 之後 + noon 正午

example.en: Many business travelers prefer electronic boarding passes over traditional printed paper documents.
example.zh: 許多商務旅客比起傳統紙本列印憑證更偏好使用電子登機證。

words.mnemonic: 文法偏好比較考點：prefer A to B (喜歡A甚於B)。
roots: fer 攜帶 → 把某物放前面

example.en: The store extended its opening hours.
example.zh: 他們同意將截止日期延長兩天。

words.mnemonic: extend a deadline or service。

example.en: Management met to explore the possibility of expanding commercial distribution into Asian markets.
example.zh: 管理層會面以探討將商業經銷網絡擴展進軍亞洲市場的可能性。

words.mnemonic: 商機探討片語：explore the possibility of (探討...的可能性)。

example.en: Please follow the step-by-step assembly directions enclosed in the furniture product package.
example.zh: 請遵守家具產品包裝內所附之逐步組裝說明指南。

words.mnemonic: 說明書指南：follow directions (遵守說明)、ask for directions (問路)。

example.en: The corporate cafeteria offers a wide variety of fresh salads, hot entrees, and healthy beverages.
example.zh: 企業員工餐廳提供各式各樣豐富的新鮮沙拉、熱食主菜與健康飲品。

words.mnemonic: 商品多元性必背片語：a wide variety of (各式各樣的)。

example.en: Hotel room rates include complimentary daily breakfast and high-speed wireless internet access.
example.zh: 飯店客房費率包含每日免費早餐與高速無線網路連線。

words.mnemonic: 日常與出勤用語：daily routine (日常作息)、daily rate (每日費率)。

example.en: Employees should wear business casual clothes in accordance with the corporate workplace dress code.
example.zh: 員工應當依據企業職場服儀規範穿著商務休閒服裝。

words.mnemonic: 複數名詞，無單數形：casual clothes (休閒服裝)、work clothes (工作服)。

example.en: The weather forecast predicts rain.
example.zh: 最新的市場趨勢預測顯示明年度消費需求將強勁復甦。

reviewWords.mnemonic: forecast future conditions。

example.en: The airline canceled the flight.
example.zh: 旅客因暴風雨受困，不得不取消原本預訂的航班。

reviewWords.mnemonic: cancel a reservation or event。

reviewWords.mnemonic: assign a task。

reviewWords.mnemonic: guideline 是行動規則。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 交通方式的總稱。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 企業總收入。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 大量或音量。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 場所的位置。

example.zh: 行銷部門本季度的首要目標是提升品牌知名度。

reviewWords.mnemonic: objective = goal。

example.en: The bank opened a new branch.
example.zh: 該銀行將於下個月在西區開設新分行。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 公司或銀行的分支。

example.zh: 宴會大廳最多可容納四百名賓客入席。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 可容納的人數。

example.zh: 所有實驗室作業皆必須符合政府環保規章。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 正式規則。

example.en: The company plans to hire two assistants.
example.zh: 公司計畫於第四季度招募五名軟體工程師。

reviewWords.mnemonic: hire new staff。

example.en: The product comes with a one-year guarantee.
example.zh: 所有電器設備皆附帶為期一年的品質保固。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 保證品質或結果。

example.en: Read the instructions before use.
example.zh: 組裝辦公家具前請先詳細閱讀說明書。

reviewWords.mnemonic: instructions 通常用複數。

example.en: The manager handled the complaint quickly.
example.zh: 客戶服務中心正在審理顧客對配送延誤的投訴。

reviewWords.mnemonic: customer complaint。

example.en: The employer offers flexible hours.
example.zh: 作為負責任的雇主，公司提供完善的健康保險。

reviewWords.mnemonic: employ 別人的人。

example.zh: 確保職場安全始終是我們工廠的最優先考量。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 最重要的事情。

example.zh: 該職位提供極具競爭力的薪資與獎金制度。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 固定薪資。

example.zh: 搭乘計程車前往會展中心大約需要四十分鐘車程。

reviewWords.mnemonic: approximately = about。

example.en: Technicians will install the new software.
example.zh: 技術團隊本週末將在伺服器機房安裝新空調設備。

reviewWords.mnemonic: install equipment or software。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 占用時間或空間。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 採購與業務請購必備動詞，片語 in need of 意為需要。

example.zh: 今年將提撥多少資金給員工身心健康計畫？

reviewWords.mnemonic: 詢問預算與花費的固定問法：how much + 不可數名詞。

example.en: The interview panel agreed that Mr. Gomez is the right candidate for the position.
example.zh: 面試小組一致認為戈梅茲先生是擔任該職位的合適人選。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 招募常用 the right candidate 表最理想人選；亦有 right now (馬上)。

example.en: I am currently in a client conference, but I will call you back before five o'clock.
example.zh: 我目前正在與客戶開會，但我會在五點前回電給您。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 電話商務必考片語：call back (回電)、get back to someone (回覆某人)。

example.en: The revised safety protocol means that all factory workers must wear protective helmets.
example.zh: 修訂後的安全規範意味著所有工廠作業人員皆必須配戴安全帽。

example.zh: 新升級的自動化系統運作起來甚至比先前的機型更為迅速。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 用於加強比較級語氣 (even faster) 或片語 even though (雖然)。

example.zh: 請在收據的這裡簽名，以確認已收到包裹。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 快遞簽收與櫃檯接待高頻指示副詞：sign here (在此簽名)。

example.zh: 許多資深工程師上週五參加了該區域科技博覽會。

example.zh: 毫無疑問，數位自動化將會顯著提升倉儲物流的長期生產力。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益閱讀必考肯定強烈片語：without a doubt / little doubt (毫無疑問)。

example.en: Local retailers face intense market competition from multinational online e-commerce platforms.
example.zh: 在地實體零售商正面臨來自跨國線上電商平台極為激烈的市場競爭。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 市場抗衡詞彙：stiff competition / fierce competition (激烈競爭)。

example.en: The seminar presenter explained how management theory applies to modern distributed remote teams.
example.zh: 研討會主講人深入闡釋了管理學理論如何具體應用於現代分散式遠距團隊。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 理論與實務對比：in theory (理論上)、in practice (實務上)。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務提案核心動詞：propose a plan (提出方案)；衍生名詞 proposal (提案書)。

example.en: Job applicants are required to furnish at least two professional employment references.
example.zh: 求職應徵者依規定須提供至少兩位專業前雇主推薦人名單。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 求職推薦與編號查證：reference letter (推薦信)、reference number (參照編號)。

example.en: The consultant presented a compelling financial argument in favor of upgrading to cloud servers.
example.zh: 顧問提出了一項令人信服的財務論據，力挺全面升級為雲端伺服器。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 支持提案論點：compelling argument (令人信服的論據)。

example.en: The trade exhibition entrance fee is twenty dollars for adults and complimentary for children.
example.zh: 該商貿展覽會入場費成人為二十美元，兒童則免費招待。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 票價費率分類：adult fare (成人票價)、adult passenger (成年旅客)。

example.en: Corporate business executives frequently fly commercial business class on transatlantic routes.
example.zh: 企業高階主管在跨大西洋航線上經常搭乘商業商務艙飛行出差。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 航空出差動詞：frequent flyer (飛行常客)、fly direct (搭直航班機)。

example.en: Market analysts identified a noticeable shift in consumer purchasing patterns over the holiday period.
example.zh: 市場分析師在節慶期間發現了消費者購物模式型態的顯著轉變。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 市場行為分析：spending patterns (消費型態/消費模式)。

example.en: Job candidates must submit their completed employment application online before Friday.
example.zh: 求職候選人必須在週五前於線上提交填寫完畢的應徵求職申請表。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 求職與行動軟體必考：job application (求職申請)、mobile application (手機應用程式)。

example.en: Customers seeking immediate technical assistance may dial our twenty-four-hour telephone hotline.
example.zh: 尋求即時技術協助的客戶可隨時撥打我們的二十四小時電話諮詢熱線。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客服電話必考：telephone hotline (諮詢熱線)、hot item (熱銷商品)。

example.en: Upgrading automated equipment obviously helped our factory increase daily manufacturing throughput.
example.zh: 升級自動化設備顯然幫助了我們的工廠提高每日製造產量吞吐。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 顯而易見副詞：obviously true (顯而易見屬實)。

example.en: If any instructions on the assembly diagram remain unclear, contact the support supervisor.
example.zh: 若組裝圖解上的任何說明指示依然不明確，請立即聯絡支援主管。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 字首 un- 反義詞：clear (清楚) -> unclear (不清楚/不明朗)。

example.en: Hotel guests may review their finalized itemized room bill at the front desk prior to departure.
example.zh: 飯店房客在退房出發前可於接待櫃檯審閱其最終的逐項客房費用帳單。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 飯店退房與帳務出帳：itemized bill (明細帳單)、utility bill (水電費帳單)。

example.en: Users can search our online electronic archives by keyword or document identification number.
example.zh: 使用者可以透過關鍵字或文件身分編號檢索我們的線上電子檔案庫。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 人資獵才與線上搜尋：executive search (高階主管獵才)、search engine (搜尋引擎)。

example.en: Please submit travel lodging receipts and client meal expenses on separate reimbursement forms.
example.zh: 請將差旅住宿收據與客戶餐費支出分別填寫在各自獨立的報銷申請表上。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 分開報帳與個別處理：separate forms (各自獨立的表格)、separate cover (另函寄送)。
roots: par 準備 → 分開安排

example.en: The corporate headquarters is situated in a prominent central location adjacent to the subway.
example.zh: 企業總部位於緊鄰捷運站的地標精華核心地段。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 選址核心詞：central location (黃金核心位置)、central office (總辦公室)。

example.en: The enterprise actively supports ongoing professional development and employee career advancement.
example.zh: 該企業積極支持持續專業在職進修與員工職涯升遷發展。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 招募網站專區：career opportunities (職涯機會)、career fair (就業博覽會)。

example.en: Although the budget estimate was preliminary, the committee decided to proceed with the bid anyway.
example.zh: 儘管預算估算僅為初步性質，委員會依然決定無論如何都要推進該項投標。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 語氣轉折副詞：anyway = regardless (無論如何)。

example.en: The company president delivered an inspiring keynote speech at the annual international trade banquet.
example.zh: 公司總裁在年度國際商貿晚宴上發表了鼓舞人心的主題演講。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 演講動詞搭配：give a speech / deliver a speech (發表演說)。

example.en: The luxury hotel allows certified guide dogs to accompany guests inside all dining and lodging areas.
example.zh: 該豪華飯店允許經認證的導盲犬陪同房客進入所有餐飲與住宿區域。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 飯店無障礙規定：guide dog (導盲犬)、service dog (服務犬)。

example.en: The chief financial officer presented the finalized annual auditing report to the board of directors.
example.zh: 財務長向董事會正式呈報了最終年度審計報告。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 高階主管頭銜縮寫必背：CEO (執行長)、CFO (財務長)、security officer (保全專員)。

example.en: Complimentary wireless internet connectivity is accessible throughout the entire conference center.
example.zh: 全體會議中心全區內部均可連線使用免費無線網路。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 遍及範圍與整段時間：throughout the year (全年)、throughout the building (遍及整座大樓)。

example.en: Factory maintenance mechanics regularly check lubricating oil levels across all production machines.
example.zh: 工廠維護技師定期檢查所有生產機具的潤滑機油液位。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 設備潤滑與能源：crude oil (原油)、oil change (換機油)。

example.en: All corporate employees are required to adhere to business professional dress code guidelines.
example.zh: 所有企業員工皆必須遵守商務專業服儀規範準則。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 公司人事規範大考點：dress code (服儀規定)、business casual dress (商務休閒服裝)。

example.en: The business reported a higher profit.
example.zh: 公司本季度實現了豐厚的利潤。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 收入扣除成本後的錢。
roots: fit 做 → 向前的成果

example.en: I guess we should reconfirm tomorrow's conference room booking with the administrative secretary.
example.zh: 我想我們應該跟行政秘書再次確認明天會議室的預訂登記情況。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 口語聽力委婉表達：I guess so (我想也是)、take a guess (猜猜看)。

example.en: The corporate employee wellness committee organized a fun weekend retreat for staff and families.
example.zh: 企業員工健康委員會為同仁及眷屬籌辦了一次充滿樂趣的週末研習營。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 員工聯誼活動描寫：have fun (玩得開心)、fun activity (有趣的活動)。

example.en: Factory employees must wear specialized protective helmets and boots to protect against workplace injury.
example.zh: 工廠員工必須穿戴專用防護頭盔與防護鞋靴以防範職場工傷意外。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 資安與工安核心動詞：protect against (防範/抵禦)、protect data (保護資料)。
roots: tect 覆蓋 → 擋在前面遮蓋

example.en: The corporate human resources division oversees employee recruitment, benefits, and staff training.
example.zh: 企業人力資源部門負責督導員工招募、福利與同仁培訓進修。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益最重要的部門：human resources (HR, 人力資源部)。
roots: source 湧出 (surgere) → 再度湧現的來源

example.en: Our pharmaceutical research laboratory applies cutting-edge medical science to vaccine development.
example.zh: 我們的製藥研發實驗室將尖端醫學科技應用於疫苗開發。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 高科技研發名詞：computer science (資訊科學)、science park (科學園區)。

example.en: The corporate health insurance package provides full diagnostic coverage for chronic disease treatments.
example.zh: 企業健康保險套裝福利針對慢性疾病的診療提供全面的給付保障。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 健保福利與防疫：prevent disease (預防疾病)、infectious disease (傳染病)。

example.en: Please ensure that the remaining account balance is fully settled before the end of the billing cycle.
example.zh: 請確保帳戶剩餘應付結餘款在該出帳週期結束前全額結清。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益財會與人事兩大王牌：account balance (帳戶餘額)、work-life balance (工作與生活平衡)。

example.en: Customers should inspect delivered packages immediately and report any transit damage to the courier.
example.zh: 顧客在貨物送達時應立即檢查包裹，並向快遞公司回報任何運送損壞。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 不可數名詞大考點：cause damage (造成損壞)、damaged goods (受損商品)。

example.en: Our facility security team conducts preventative equipment maintenance checks on a daily basis.
example.zh: 我們的廠房保全維護團隊每日定期進行預防性設備檢驗。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益超級頻率片語：on a daily basis (每天)、on a regular basis (定期)。

example.en: The keynote speaker is a distinguished author of several bestselling management strategy handbooks.
example.zh: 特邀主講嘉賓是數本暢銷管理策略實務手冊的知名作家作者。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 出版品作者：lead author (主要作者)、book author (圖書作家)。

example.en: All newly hired administrative assistants must demonstrate basic proficiency in spreadsheet applications.
example.zh: 所有新進行政助理皆必須展現操作試算表應用軟體的基本熟練能力。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 入門要求：basic skills (基本技能)、basic salary (底薪)。

example.en: Corporate leadership encourages staff members to pursue ongoing professional education and certification.
example.zh: 企業領導層大力鼓勵同仁攻讀持續專業進修課程並考取專業證照。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益高頻句型：encourage someone to do something (鼓勵某人做某事)。

example.en: Factory operators working on food processing lines must wear protective hairnets at all times.
example.zh: 在食品加工流水線上作業的工廠員工在任何時候皆必須配戴防護髮網。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 食品安全工安規章：hair net (髮網)。

example.en: Company employment policies strictly enforce equal opportunities for male and female job applicants.
example.zh: 公司就業政策嚴格落實對男女求職應徵者一律平等的就業機會。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 性別平權招募用語：male and female (男性與女性)。

example.en: The accounting division keeps an accurate electronic record of all commercial transactions.
example.zh: 會計部門對所有商務交易皆保存有精確無誤的電子紀錄。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 動詞 /rɪˈkɔːrd/ 記錄；名詞 /ˈrɛkərd/ 檔案紀錄：track record (過往績效紀錄)。

example.en: Hotel guests who extend their stay by two days will receive complimentary spa vouchers.
example.zh: 延長住宿兩天的飯店房客將可獲得免費水療抵用券。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 旅館住宿與狀態維持：stay at a hotel (住飯店)、stay informed (保持知悉)。

example.zh: 該企業正在擴大其工程人力團隊，以滿足對雲端服務日益增長的需求。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益職場最常考複合字：workforce (勞動力/全體員工)、task force (特遣專案小組)。

example.en: The express airport shuttle makes a brief passenger pickup stop outside terminal two.
example.zh: 機場快捷接駁車會在第二航廈外做短暫的旅客上車停靠。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 交通工具停靠：bus stop (公車站)；non-stop (直達的/不間斷的)。

example.en: The hiring committee interviewed several qualified candidates for the senior accounting position.
example.zh: 招募委員會面試了數名具備資歷的應徵者以填補資深會計職缺。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 修飾複數可數名詞：several times (好幾次)、several options (好幾個選項)。

example.en: Please ensure that all overhead office lights are switched off before locking up the building.
example.zh: 在鎖門離開大樓前，請確保所有辦公室頭頂照明皆已關閉。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務轉折短語：in light of (有鑑於...)；lightweight (輕量級的)。

example.en: Our software engineers worked diligently to develop a user-friendly mobile banking application.
example.zh: 我們的軟體工程師勤奮工作，以開發出一款操作簡便的手機網銀應用程式。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 研發核心動詞：develop a product (開發產品)、develop a plan (擬定計畫)。

example.en: Please remember to attach your itemized expense receipts when requesting travel reimbursement.
example.zh: 申請差旅費報銷時，請務必記得檢附逐項列記的支出收據。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 叮嚀句型必備：remember to do (記得去做某事)。

example.en: The final contract negotiations took a bit longer than originally anticipated by management.
example.zh: 最終的合約談判比管理層原先預期的時間稍微久了一點。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 副詞修飾片語：a bit (稍微/一點點)、bit by bit (循序漸進)。

example.en: Our new smartphone product line helped the enterprise expand its global market share.
example.zh: 我們的新智慧型手機產品線幫助企業擴大了其全球市場份額。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業金融大考點：market share (市占率)、shareholders (股東)。

example.en: The corporate expansion committee consulted an experienced real estate agency to locate new offices.
example.zh: 企業擴張委員會諮詢了一家經驗豐富的房地產經紀公司以尋找新辦公室。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益商業核心考點：real estate (不動產/房地產)。

example.en: Our customer service representatives strive to answer incoming telephone calls within three rings.
example.zh: 我們的客戶服務代表力求在響鈴三聲內接聽進線電話。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 辦公室電話與客服關鍵動詞：answer the phone (接聽電話)。

example.en: Meeting participants are invited to sit around the central conference table.
example.zh: 邀請與會者圍繞中央會議桌就座。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 會議就座用語：sit at a desk (坐在辦公桌前)、be seated (就座)。

example.en: The chief financial officer presented the latest sales figures during the executive briefing.
example.zh: 財務長在主管簡報會議上報告了最新的銷售數據。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 財報最常考名詞：sales figures (銷售數字)、figure out (想出/弄明白)。

example.en: Candidates must submit a cover letter and an updated resume to be considered for the position.
example.zh: 應徵者必須提交求職信與更新的履歷表方能列入該職位的考量。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 求職與推薦必備：cover letter (求職信)、letter of recommendation (推薦信)。

example.en: The board of directors will decide whether to approve the international merger proposal tomorrow.
example.zh: 董事會將於明天決定是否核准該項跨國合併提案。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 決策核心動詞：decide to do (決定做某事)、decide on (決定選擇)。
roots: cide 切 → 切斷猶豫、決定

example.en: Fluency in a second foreign language is a definite advantage for our global marketing applicants.
example.zh: 精通第二外語對於應徵我們全球行銷職缺的求職者而言是一項顯著優勢。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 履歷專長必填欄位：foreign language (外語)、body language (肢體語言)。

example.en: Please write a concise and clear subject line when emailing client project updates.
example.zh: 在透過電子郵件寄送客戶專案進度時，請填寫簡潔明瞭的主旨欄。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 書信主旨與合約條件：subject line (郵件主旨)、subject to change (可能隨時變更)。
roots: ject 丟 → 丟在下面、受支配者

example.en: Corporate business executives traveling on flights over eight hours are eligible for business class.
example.zh: 搭乘飛行時間超過八小時航班的企業高階主管有資格搭乘商務艙。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 機票艙等考點：business class (商務艙)、first class (頭等艙)。

example.en: The enterprise invests heavily in professional employee development and technical training.
example.zh: 該企業大力投資於員工的專業發展與技術培訓。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 科技與人事專有名詞：research and development (研發/R&D)。

example.en: Our newly renovated flagship hotel is centrally situated in the historic section of town.
example.zh: 我們新裝修的旗艦飯店位於該城鎮歷史區的中心地帶。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 市中心核心字：downtown (市中心)、out of town (出城/不在本地)。

example.en: The airport shuttle departs from terminal two every half hour throughout the day.
example.zh: 機場接駁車全天每半小時自第二航廈發車一班。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 時間與財報考點：half an hour (半小時)、first half of the year (上半年)。

example.en: The executive secretary distributed the official meeting minutes to all committee members.
example.zh: 執行秘書向所有委員會成員分發了正式的會議紀錄。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙重考點：單數是「分鐘」，複數 meeting minutes 則是「會議紀錄」！

example.en: The corporate catering service provided exquisite food and beverages for the banquet.
example.zh: 企業外燴服務為晚宴提供了精緻的餐飲美食與飲料。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 活動餐飲詞彙：food and beverage (餐飲服務/F&B)、food court (美食街)。

example.en: Workshop attendees will enjoy a fifteen-minute coffee break before the afternoon session begins.
example.zh: 工作坊與會者將在下午會議開始前享受十五分鐘的咖啡茶歇時間。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 會議中場休息：coffee break (茶歇)、take a break (休息一下)。

example.en: The supervisor gave clear and direct instructions on how to file travel reimbursement claims.
example.zh: 主管對於如何申報差旅費報銷提出了清楚而直接的指示。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 清晰度與物流通關：make it clear (說明清楚)、clear customs (通關)。

example.en: We look forward to exploring mutually beneficial business opportunities in the near future.
example.zh: 我們期盼在不久的將來共同探討互利共贏的商業商機。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 書信客套結尾句：in the near future (在不久的將來)。

example.en: Invoices can be settled using either corporate credit cards or direct electronic wire transfers.
example.zh: 發票可以透過企業信用卡或直接電子電匯轉帳任一方式進行結清。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 二選一必考配對句型：either A or B (要麼A要麼B)。

example.en: The new regional warehouse facility became fully operational three months ago.
example.zh: 這座新的區域倉儲設施在三個月前已完全投入營運。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 過去式標誌時間副詞：three days ago (三天前)。

example.en: The parking garage charges four dollars per hour during standard business daytime hours.
example.zh: 該停車場在一般日間營業時段每小時收費四美元。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 計算單位與依據：per hour (每小時)、as per your request (依照您的要求)。

example.en: Despite severe economic market fluctuations, our net operating margins remained strong.
example.zh: 儘管面臨嚴峻的經濟市場波動，我們的營業淨利率依然維持強勁。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 狀態維持動詞：remain competitive (保持競爭力)、remain seated (請保持就坐)。

example.en: Ensuring workplace physical safety remains the top priority of factory plant management.
example.zh: 確保工作場所的人身安全始終是工廠廠房管理層的首要之務。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 第一優先與高階管理：top priority (最高優先)、top management (高層管理)。

example.en: Our lightweight laptop was ranked among the top three models in terms of battery efficiency.

example.en: Factory technicians decided to pause the assembly line briefly to replace a worn drive belt.
example.zh: 工廠技術人員決定短暫暫停組裝流水線，以更換磨損的傳動皮帶。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 暫停中斷動詞：pause the video (暫停影片)、pause production (暫停生產)。

example.en: Everyone in the office is cordially invited to attend the annual employee recognition reception.
example.zh: 誠摯邀請辦公室的全體同仁出席年度優秀員工表揚茶會。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益文法必考：everyone 作主詞時，動詞一律接「單數動詞」！

example.en: Please do not forget to submit your signed timesheet to the payroll department by Friday noon.
example.zh: 請不要忘記在週五中午前將您簽名確認的出勤工時表繳交至薪資核算部。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 備忘提醒句型：Don't forget to do (別忘了做某事)。

example.en: Clients can browse our full product catalog and request price quotes on our home page.
example.zh: 客戶可在我們的官方網站首頁上瀏覽完整產品目錄並索取報價。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 網路行銷與機場廣播：home page (首頁)、page a passenger (在機場廣播呼叫旅客)。

example.en: Do not worry if your original receipt is misplaced; our customer care team can look up the order.
example.zh: 若您的原始收據遺失請無需擔心，我們的客服關懷團隊可直接替您查詢該筆訂單。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 安撫客戶情緒常用句型：Don't worry about (不用擔心...)。

example.en: The corporate marketing department welcomes ten university interns during our annual summer program.
example.zh: 企業行銷部在我們的年度暑期實習計畫中熱烈歡迎十名大學生實習生。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 季節性招募與促銷：summer internship (暑期實習)、summer sale (夏季特賣)。

example.en: Complimentary cold drinks and light snacks will be served during the afternoon seminar break.
example.zh: 下午研討會茶歇期間將供應免費冰飲與精緻點心。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 招待餐飲詞彙：complimentary drink (免費招待飲料)、soft drink (無酒精汽水)。

example.en: We highly value your opinion and invite you to complete our brief customer feedback survey.
example.zh: 我們非常重視您的寶貴意見，並竭誠邀請您填寫我們簡短的客戶回饋問卷。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 問卷與會議表達：in my opinion (依我之見)、ask for an opinion (徵詢意見)。

example.en: Our new corporate technology headquarters is situated inside a modern green business park.
example.zh: 我們全新的企業科技總部座落於一座現代化的綠色商業園區內。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙重考點：business park / office park (商辦園區)；動詞 park a car (停車)。

example.en: Ms. Tanaka was selected to represent our regional marketing division at the Tokyo software summit.
example.zh: 田中女士獲選代表我們的區域行銷部門出席東京軟體高峰會。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業代表與發言：represent the company (代表公司)；衍生 sales representative (業務代表)。

example.en: Fostering client trust is the key factor that drives our corporate commercial expansion.
example.zh: 培養客戶信任是推動我們企業商務擴張的關鍵核心要素。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 簡報重點形容詞：key factor (關鍵因素)、keynote speaker (主講嘉賓)。

example.en: Smoking is strictly prohibited inside all corporate office complexes and manufacturing facilities.
example.zh: 所有企業辦公園區與生產廠房設施內部一律嚴格禁止吸菸。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 場所指示介系詞：inside the building (大樓內部)。

example.en: Our marketing delegation will attend the upcoming international software trade conference in Berlin.
example.zh: 我們的行銷代表團將參加即將在柏林舉行的國際軟體貿易大會。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 字首 inter- 表「在...之間」，搭配 national 即國際間的。

example.en: The attached electronic spreadsheet contains detailed expenditure records for the second quarter.
example.zh: 隨附的電子試算表內含有第二季度的詳細支出紀錄。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 檔案與貨品內容描述動詞；名詞 container (貨櫃/容器)。

example.en: I was wondering if the corporate accounting department has approved our travel reimbursement claim.
example.zh: 我想了解一下企業會計部門是否已經核准了我們的差旅報銷申請。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務書信客氣詢問開頭：I was wondering if... (不知是否能...)。

example.en: Due to the sensitive confidential nature of the project, all team members must sign non-disclosure agreements.
example.zh: 鑑於該專案敏感的保密性質，所有團隊成員皆必須簽署保密協定。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益正式商務公文搭配：by its nature (本質上)、confidential nature (機密性質)。

example.en: The executive board introduced a new organizational management structure to accelerate decision-making.
example.zh: 執行董事會推出了一項新的組織管理架構，以加速決策進行。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 公司組織與費率名詞：organizational structure (組織架構)、fee structure (收費結構)。

example.en: Please refer to the technical specifications section on page twelve of the user manual.
example.zh: 請參閱使用手冊第十二頁的技術規格區塊。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 文件與區域劃分詞彙：non-smoking section (禁菸區)、cross-section (橫切面)。

example.en: I will inspect the newly renovated corporate conference facility myself before the annual meeting.
example.zh: 在年度大會之前，我將親自視察全新裝修的企業會議設施。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 主詞強調用法：by myself (獨自)、see for myself (親自去看看)。

example.en: The invoice amount must match the approved purchase order estimate exactly before payment processing.
example.zh: 發票金額在撥款前必須與核准的採購訂單估算完全精準吻合。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 精確性副詞：not exactly (不完全是)、exactly what we need (正是我們需要的)。
